_comment: Single source of truth for each playable race. Read by the game (race picker tooltips, race-pick chat message, guidebook heritage page, RaceStats modifiers, RaceAbilityBonuses) and used to generate the race table in docs/races/races.md: after editing, run ./gradlew generateRaceTable. abilityBonuses use STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA and are added to the character sheet. stats are attribute modifiers on top of the class: speed is a fraction of base movement speed (0.05 = +5%), maxHealth is in half-hearts (2 = one heart), knockbackResistance is 0-1, attackRange is in blocks. scale is the planned body size (not applied yet). Write each trait as a short phrase without a trailing full stop.

races.name: Human
races.summary: Adaptable and ambitious, at home anywhere
traits: **Ambitious**: +10% class XP from every source
**Diplomat**: +2 on Persuasion and other social checks

races.name: Elf
races.summary: Graceful forest folk with keen senses
traits: **Darkvision**: caves are dim but readable
**Keen Senses**: while sneaking, see hostile mobs within 12 blocks through walls
**Trance**: never need sleep, so phantoms never come for you

races.name: Dwarf
races.summary: Stout, stubborn and hard to knock down
traits: **Darkvision**: caves are dim but readable
**Dwarven Resilience**: poison lasts half as long and hurts half as much
**Stonecunning**: mine stone, deepslate and ores 20% faster

races.name: Halfling
traits: **Lucky**: a natural 1 on a d20 is rerolled once
**Small**: sneak through one-block gaps
**Second Breakfast**: food restores one extra hunger point

races.name: Gnome
races.summary: Small tinkerers who shrug off magic
traits: **Darkvision**: caves are dim but readable
**Gnome Cunning**: 30% less damage from magic
**Tinker**: crafting a redstone component has a 25% chance to make one extra

races.name: Half-Orc
races.summary: Fierce and enduring, hard to put down
traits: **Darkvision**: caves are dim but readable
**Relentless Endurance**: once every 10 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead
**Savage Attacks**: critical hits deal x2.5 instead of x2

races.name: Tiefling
races.summary: Infernal heritage, at ease in fire
traits: **Darkvision**: caves are dim but readable
**Hellish Resistance**: half damage from fire, lava and burning
**Hellish Rebuke**: a melee attacker is set on fire (20 second cooldown)

races.name: Dragonborn
races.summary: Dragon-blooded, with a breath weapon of their ancestry
traits: **Draconic Ancestry**: Ember (fire), Frost or Storm (lightning)
**Breath Weapon**: breathe your ancestry's element in a cone (R key)
**Draconic Resistance**: half damage from your ancestry's element
